g.text: Original diode was M7 (1A Si diode) Replacement is 1A Schottky Or MOSFET switch

The FTDI chip outputs 3.3V logic, but with CMOS logic this is right at the limit of logic high on a 5V device (5V*0.7=3.5V). If the temperature rises, the required transition level will increase and may fail in some situations.
Default = 5V Cut trace and solder to 3V3 to change
